text:
jordan_sales: quick presales sync. Prospect wants a 2-week POC strictly inside AWS Wavelength (us-east-1-wl4). Requirements: inference traffic + BYO-KMS must stay in-zone; they also want a short subprocessor list limited to Redwood services and a one-off POC cost. Can we do this without major blockers?
infra_monica: short: compute in wl4 = yes for Dedicated/Private. full in-zone control plane = not standard. for POC we can: (A) run runtime in wl4, (B) accept BYO-KMS via their VPC endpoint, (C) disable telemetry egress or mirror a tiny control-plane proxy in their VPC. proxy adds ~3 business days for validation. also need ENI/peering docs and exact instance SKUs to validate.
sre_tom: ops checklist to return to customer: - carrier legal entity + peering contact - WL subnet details (CIDR, MTU) and ENI plan - BYO-KMS ARN + VPC endpoint and cross-account policy for our runtime principal - QPS / concurrency / typical prompt length for sizing - acceptance of reject-on-no-capacity vs fallback behavior
jordan_sales: they listed telco as "AuroraConnect Mobile LLC" in the RFQ. they prefer reject-on-no-capacity (no automatic fallback). they also want an ops-ready snippet showing strict zone enforcement + BYO-KMS hint we can paste into the SOW.
ops_sam: share this minimal snippet for strict POC, and include the caveat paragraph. emphasize that strict mode may reject requests when wl4 is saturated.

```yaml
routing_policy:
  mode: "zone-strict"
  preferred_zone: "us-east-1-wl4"
  fallback: []
  byo_kms: true
  kms_vpc_endpoint: "vpce-0abcd1234efgh5678"
  telemetry: "disabled"
  kv_cache: "disabled"
  enforcement: "reject-on-no-capacity"
```

ops_sam: caveat paragraph to include in email: "This configuration enforces execution only inside us-east-1-wl4. If capacity in the Wavelength zone is exhausted, requests will be rejected. We recommend agreeing on an explicit failover plan for production. Control-plane signaling by default reaches Redwood's control plane region; to avoid this we will deploy a small control-plane proxy inside your VPC for the duration of the POC (validation ~3 business days). BYO-KMS must provide a VPC endpoint and cross-account policy granting decrypt access to the runtime principal. Some observability features (token-level logs, external metrics) will be disabled unless customer-managed sinks are provided inside the Wavelength VPC."

legal_rina: legal note: we will provide Redwood's subprocessor manifest (auth, runtime, monitoring agent, storage). carrier/ISP subprocessors are separate third parties; if the customer requires contractual "carrier-only" guarantees on the network path, we need a scoped DPA appendix and an attestation from AuroraConnect. I'll draft a short attestation template the customer can send to the telco.
deploy-bot: PR-11001 created: wl4-proxy-validation (ETA 72h).
jordan_sales: thanks team. i'll collect the AuroraConnect PoA, ENI contact, and the KMS vpce info. prospect also wants a preliminary POC price for 2 weeks with isolation and on-call validation. ops_sam any ballpark?
ops_sam: ballpark uplift: +25-35% on top of base dedicated rate for single-zone isolation and validation fee. final quote needs SKU, QPS, and exact test window.
jordan_sales: i'll get QPS (they said ~8 rps) and SKU from procurement. i'll send the snippet + caveats + request attestation template. will update when i have artifacts. cheers :thumbsup:
